title: The Pullman conservatory's glass front looks like its photograph
items: The big arched glass front of the Pullman conservatory, across 18th Street, now shows plants in shade behind its glass. Before, it looked like a solid grey wall over a black doorway.
Under the arch, a row of round-topped windows in white frames now runs above the stone base, as in a photograph from about 1897.
The lodge beside it can now be compared with the same two pictures. Its curved porch front and the gate piers are still missing.
